title: Rooftop Observing Platform
description: One static rooftop-observing scene from the original astronomy scene program. A complete original tripod telescope occupies the left observing area, its separate complete observing chair sits behind it, and a complete star-chart console is beside the open front approach. One newly authored scene-only roof slab has three integral thick parapets and an open front access edge. All original local POSITION/NORMAL, materials and internal node transforms are retained at unit scale, with translation-only placement. One scene, zero new independent models. Fictional visual roof platform only: no stairs, building, fall protection, safe access, telescope-eye alignment, optical operation, tracking, astronomy data, load or installation certification.
